description: How a spawn.ctl replay (history or snapshot) is split into SPCT chunks, asserted by the daemon (encoder), the web client and the mobile client (assemblers). The daemon frames every chunk as one 16 KiB SCTP message: a 28-byte header and up to 16,356 bytes of payload. A client never assumes that size; it learns the payload size from the first non-final chunk it receives, requires every non-final chunk to match it, accepts any size from min_chunk_payload_bytes to max_chunk_payload_bytes, and derives the final chunk's size from total_bytes. On 2026-09-05 the two clients assumed 48 KiB and silently discarded every replay longer than one daemon chunk; this file exists so the three runtimes cannot drift apart again.
